items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: And I wanted to thank George Welk. He says, 'Well, you don't have to thank me because you deserve every bit of it.'

ctx.x: His first Hall of Fame award which was really a great honor to be one of 11 musicians out of all the thousands of musicians in America. It was indeed a great honor and it was a fantastic concert.

Yes, it was. It was a beautiful concert and I enjoyed it very much. And I wanted to thank George Welk. He says, 'Well, you don't have to thank me because you deserve every bit of it. You should have had it years ago.' I said, 'Well, I don't know about that. I was too young to have it years ago.' And he laughed and we all laughed. But it was
really nice and it was enjoyable.
